business: Harbour Plumbing & Gas is a Port Halyard plumbing and gas business doing mostly residential work, some strata work, and maintenance on rentals for real estate agents. Dana Whitlock (owner) works with three techs and an apprentice; Priya Raman runs the office three days a week, and Sam Okafor is the external bookkeeper. Dana approves the pay run, the BAS, debt collection and any follow-up on commercial quotes over $10,000.

examples.text:
Hi [CUSTOMER_1],

Thanks for having us out on Tuesday. Please find attached invoice INV-2041 for $412.50 (inc GST) for the hot water service repair at [ADDRESS_1].

Payment is due by 30 September. Bank details are on the invoice.

Any questions, just give me a call on (08) 5550 1234.

Cheers,
Priya
Harbour Plumbing & Gas

Hi [CUSTOMER_2],

Just a friendly reminder that invoice INV-2032 for $286.00 was due on 21 September and is now a week overdue. I've attached a copy in case it got lost.

If you've already paid, please ignore this, and thank you!

Cheers,
Priya
Harbour Plumbing & Gas

Hi [BOOKKEEPER_1],

September's receipts and the Coastline bills are in the Receipts/2026-09 folder in Drive. There are two Coastline bills I couldn't match to jobs, so I've put them in a subfolder called 'unmatched'.

Cheers,
Priya
Harbour Plumbing & Gas

drafts.trigger: A quote sent from Xero has had no reply for 7 days
drafts.outputFormat: Plain-text email for the accounts inbox, under 120 words
qualityChecks: Quote number and total match Xero exactly
No quote over $10,000 is drafted; it is flagged to Dana instead

complianceRules: Never say that gas work is compliant or certified; compliance certificates are Dana's
stopAndFlag: Any overdue amount over $2,000 that is more than 45 days old
Any customer unhappy with a bill or a quote
Any mention of lawyers, a tribunal or debt collectors

glossary.meaning: The job management app the techs use on their phones
Work order number from a real estate agency; must be on agency invoices
Strata plan number; goes in the reference on strata invoices
Coastline Plumbing Supplies, the main parts supplier, on monthly account
Business activity statement, prepared quarterly by the bookkeeper and signed off by Dana
The apprentice's paid training days, which don't appear in JobLog
